about: Import layers for openadapt_flow, checked by tests/test_import_layers.py. Core modules are the runtime and the verifier. They must not import app-specific, benchmark, desktop-UI, or lab and harness code, directly or through any chain of openadapt_flow imports, including lazy imports inside functions. Fix a violating import rather than loosening this file. An edge that cannot be removed yet goes in exceptions with its reason and an issue link.

exceptions.reason: The qualification oracle gate runs its break-it fault against the bundled MockMed fault server, its only fixture. Core reaches the gate through receipt > repair.standard_change > repair.self_repair > agent.repair > agent.authoring > agent.bridge > agent.admission > admit_pipeline > qualification_proposal. Removing the edge means passing the fault fixture in from the caller, which changes the gate and its callers.
Runs only because the excepted qualification_oracle_gate > mockmed.fault_server import loads the mockmed package, whose __init__ re-exports the MockMed server. It goes away with that edge.
The fault server renders MockMed's chart pages. It runs only because of the excepted qualification_oracle_gate > mockmed.fault_server import, and goes away with that edge.
